answer: To claim a grading seat, an agent locks 36 POA for 18 days and may hold at most 3 vouchers. Each voucher posts 12 POA onto a shared island registry and burns 1 POA of saffron, a non-transferable fee minted only after 10 days of attested mining. If two vouched addresses sign the same live audit nonce or collide on mine nonces, the lotus slash burns 24 POA from every locked pile and strips the voucher of panel rights for 20 days. A farm must source uncorrelated, mining-backed vouchers per head and still forfeits 24 POA per detected pair, so clones cost more than one honest seat.
